acknowledgement: My sole research target in this programme is the full quadratic-form bounded-density statement for arbitrary independent cap-one coordinate laws and every symmetric matrix with at least three eigenvalues of modulus at least one.

latest_substantive_result.scope: Proved a random physical cut plus stable-rank sharpening of the independently reviewed regularized determinant theorem. Under the exact target hypotheses, off-diagonal norm <=1/4 has the existing pi*sqrt(2) bound; off-diagonal norm>1/4 and stable rank>=32 has a continuous density <70. Hence any counterexample must have off-diagonal norm>1/4 and stable rank<32.

first_unresolved_implication: QFORM-LOW-STABLERANK-OFFDIAGONAL-BRIDGE-v1: close the residual ||A-diag(A)||op>1/4, sr(A-diag(A))<32 state without reciprocal-minor loss or false conditional-independence substitutions.
next_concrete_attempt: Exploit low off-diagonal stable rank to construct a bounded number of original-coordinate banks before paying local constants, and route each bank configuration to an existing hyperbolic-square, same-sign elliptic, or regularized-determinant channel.
